items.title: An agent's undo leaves nothing to redo: the person cannot put back what an agent took back

must_fix.evidence: Found writing S1.4's test: after `emerge/operation_undo`, `redo_for_test` answers 'nothing to redo'. `operation_undo` calls `state.forget_line(..)` when a change is taken back instead of joining the history (B-019's rule: the next Cmd+Z should reach the newest change still in effect, not one the log no longer holds), and the redo stack is therefore empty. For the person's own Cmd+Z the inverse goes on the redo stack as a `Logged` entry, so a person can redo their own undo and cannot redo an agent's.
